name: jus-ai-by-jus-mundi
description: The Jus AI by Jus Mundi plugin connects ChatGPT to Jus Mundi's AI-powered global arbitration intelligence platform. Ask a legal question and get an answer grounded in Jus Mundi's curated database of awards, case documents, treaties, institutional rules, national laws, and publications, with citation-backed answers linking to the source documents.
